title: Akwaaba Monsters
description: *Akwaaba Monsters* is a **handheld-style creature-collecting game** set in tropical Ghana, built around a trip I took there with friends. Seven of its creatures are those friends.

I directed the concept and the **architecture**: a **turn-based battle engine**, a declarative **script engine** for every conversation, and a save that exports to a file. It ships **no image or audio files**: every creature, tile, letter and note is generated in the browser.
The world itself is tested, not just the code, and it is built to grow one area at a time.
imageAlt: Headline "Catch monsters across Ghana" above two pixel-art game screens: a battle between the creatures Hinoko and Polete, and the player on the dirt roads of Aduma village among thatched huts
